tool_schemas.name: analyze_twitter_profile
tool_schemas.description: Generates an AI profile analysis artifact for the target X account identified by one of: account_id, x_user_id, or x_handle (with optional leading @), optionally refetching the profile from X when refresh=true, and returns the run/output in the requested output_format (text, json, or both). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if more than one identifier is supplied, if no identifier is supplied, if workspace_id/account_id does not match the expected format, or if output_format is not one of the allowed values. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace, RATE_LIMITED when the workspace quota is exceeded, NOT_FOUND when the referenced workspace or account cannot be resolved, and CONFLICT when refresh is requested but a fetch/generation is already in progress for the same target in the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID that owns and rate-limits this run.

x_handle.description: Target X/Twitter handle to analyze (with or without leading @).

x_user_id.description: Target X/Twitter user id to analyze (numeric string).

account_id.description: Internal x_accounts.id of the target account to analyze.

refresh.description: Whether to refetch the profile from X before generating the analysis.

model.description: Model identifier to use for the generation (provider-specific).

output_format.description: Requested output shape for the artifact.

tool_schemas.name: generate_tweet
tool_schemas.description: Generates a suggested tweet in the voice/style of a specified X account (identified by exactly one of: account_id, x_user_id, or x_handle) using the provided prompt, and returns the generated artifact in the requested output_format (text, json, or both). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if prompt is missing/empty, if more than one (or no) account identifier is supplied, if workspace_id/account_id format is invalid, or if output_format is not allowed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace, RATE_LIMITED when the workspace quota is exceeded, NOT_FOUND when the workspace or target account cannot be resolved, and CONFLICT when a generation run for the same workspace/target is already active and cannot be started again.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID that owns and rate-limits this run.

x_handle.description: X/Twitter handle whose voice/style to emulate (with or without leading @).

x_user_id.description: X/Twitter user id whose voice/style to emulate (numeric string).

account_id.description: Internal x_accounts.id whose voice/style to emulate.

prompt.description: Instruction describing what to tweet about.

model.description: Model identifier to use for the generation (provider-specific).

output_format.description: Requested output shape for the artifact.

tool_schemas.name: summarize_twitter_timeline
tool_schemas.description: Builds an AI summary of a target account’s recent timeline (optionally refetching tweets when refresh=true) using up to max_tweets tweets and optional filters (include_replies/include_retweets, since/until), and returns the summary artifact in the requested output_format (text, json, or both). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if more than one (or no) account identifier is supplied, if max_tweets is provided but < 1, if since/until are not valid timestamps or since is after until, if workspace_id/account_id format is invalid, or if output_format is not allowed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace, RATE_LIMITED when the workspace quota is exceeded, NOT_FOUND when the workspace or target account cannot be resolved, and CONFLICT when refresh is requested but a fetch/summarization job for the same target is already in progress.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID that owns and rate-limits this run.

x_handle.description: Target X/Twitter handle whose timeline should be summarized (with or without leading @).

x_user_id.description: Target X/Twitter user id whose timeline should be summarized (numeric string).

account_id.description: Internal x_accounts.id whose timeline should be summarized.

refresh.description: Whether to refetch recent tweets from X before summarizing.

max_tweets.description: Maximum number of recent tweets to include as sources for the summary.

include_replies.description: Whether to include reply tweets when building the summarized timeline context.

include_retweets.description: Whether to include retweets when building the summarized timeline context.

since.description: Only include tweets posted at or after this timestamp.

until.description: Only include tweets posted at or before this timestamp.

model.description: Model identifier to use for the generation (provider-specific).

output_format.description: Requested output shape for the artifact.

tool_schemas.name: compare_perspectives
tool_schemas.description: Generates a comparative perspective report between a primary X account and a comparison X account (each identified by exactly one of: account_id, x_user_id, or x_handle), optionally refetching both profiles/timelines when refresh=true and using up to max_tweets per account as sources, returning the artifact in the requested output_format (text, json, or both). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if either side is missing an identifier or supplies multiple identifiers, if max_tweets is provided but < 1, if workspace_id/account_id formats are invalid, or if output_format is not allowed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace, RATE_LIMITED when the workspace quota is exceeded, NOT_FOUND when the workspace or either target account cannot be resolved, and CONFLICT when refresh is requested but a fetch/comparison run for the same pair is already in progress.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID that owns and rate-limits this run.

x_handle.description: Primary X/Twitter handle to compare (with or without leading @).

x_user_id.description: Primary X/Twitter user id to compare (numeric string).

account_id.description: Internal x_accounts.id of the primary account to compare.

comparison_x_handle.description: Comparison X/Twitter handle (with or without leading @).

comparison_account_id.description: Internal x_accounts.id of the comparison account.

refresh.description: Whether to refetch both profiles/timelines from X before generating the comparison.

max_tweets.description: Maximum number of recent tweets per account to include as comparison sources.

model.description: Model identifier to use for the generation (provider-specific).

output_format.description: Requested output shape for the artifact.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated principal derived from the presented API key, including workspace membership, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption for the active workspace. Refuses with AUTH_REQUIRED if no API key is presented (unless dev mode), and with KEY_REVOKED if the key is revoked.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the request. If omitted, the service may fall back to dev-mode identity when enabled.

tool_schemas.name: list_generation_runs
tool_schemas.description: Lists generation runs for a workspace in reverse chronological order with optional filtering by status, tool_name, and target accounts. Returns a paginated list of run records suitable for auditing, troubleshooting, and quota reporting. Refuses with FORBIDDEN if the API key does not belong to the workspace or workspace is deleted.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID whose runs to list.

status.description: Only return runs with this status.

tool_name.description: Only return runs created by this tool.

target_account_id.description: Only return runs whose target_account_id matches.

comparison_account_id.description: Only return runs whose comparison_account_id matches.

created_since.description: Only return runs created at or after this timestamp.

created_until.description: Only return runs created at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of runs to return (page size).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list response.

tool_schemas.name: get_generation_run
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single generation run by id, including its lifecycle status, resolved context, source_tweet_ids, and any outputs/errors. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the run does not exist or does not belong to the authenticated workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID that owns the run.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_generation_run
tool_schemas.description: Requests cancellation of an in-flight generation run by transitioning its status to cancelled. Only queued->cancelled or running->cancelled are permitted; other states are refused with INVALID_STATE. Returns the updated run record.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID that owns the run.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for audit logs.

tool_schemas.name: list_x_accounts
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached X accounts stored by the service for a workspace, with optional filtering by handle, platform, and status. Returns a paginated list of x_accounts records; does not trigger a refetch from X. Refuses with FORBIDDEN if the API key does not belong to the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID whose cached accounts to list.

platform.description: Only return accounts for this platform.

handle_prefix.description: Only return accounts whose handle starts with this prefix (case-insensitive, without @).

status.description: Only return accounts with this status.

limit.description: Maximum number of accounts to return (page size).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list response.

tool_schemas.name: update_workspace_status
tool_schemas.description: Updates a workspace lifecycle status using an allowed transition (active<->suspended, active/suspended->deleted). Direct transitions not declared by the lifecycle are refused with INVALID_STATE. Returns the updated workspace record.

status.description: New workspace status. Must be a valid lifecycle transition from the current status.

metadata.name: X MCP
metadata.description: This backend powers an MCP service that reads Twitter/X data (profiles and timelines) and produces AI-generated artifacts: profile analyses, timeline summaries, suggested tweets, and comparative perspective reports. It stores ingested X entities (accounts, tweets), caches fetch jobs, and persists us
